workOrder.title: Emergency Breakdown - Battery Charger Fail
workOrder.description: DC control supply failure alarm in control room

original_complaint_details.description: Alarm buzzed at 14:00. Output DC voltage dropped to 95V.

payload.initial_findings: Thyristor bridge fuse blown on phase B.
payload.action_taken: Replaced high-speed semiconductor fuse 100A. Checked filter capacitors and recalibrated float voltage.
payload.final_remarks: Float voltage restored to 110V DC steady.
